scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: cd backend && node -e "console.log('paso 1'); const bcrypt=require('bcryptjs'); console.log('paso 2: bcrypt cargado'); const hash=bcrypt.hashSync('admin123',10); console.log('paso 3: hash generado'); const Database=require('better-sqlite3'); console.log('paso 4: better-sqlite3 cargado'); const db=new Database('/tmp/test.sqlite'); console.log('paso 5: db abierta'); db.exec('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t (id INTEGER)'); console.log('paso 6: tabla creada'); require('http').createServer((req,res)=>res.end('ok')).listen(process.env.PORT||3000,'0.0.0.0',()=>console.log('paso 7: SERVIDOR ARRIBA'));"
